items.title: The self map given by a retraction is homotopic to the identity on the associated cosimplicial object
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file simplicial.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-push-outs-simplicial-object-w-section at source lines 5258-5269: if f : X to Y admits a retraction s with s f = id and U is the cosimplicial object built from f by iterated pushouts, then the degreewise self map given by f s on every factor is homotopic to the identity, so U is homotopy equivalent to the constant cosimplicial object X. The proof at source lines 5271-5276 is a two-sentence duality argument: the statement is dual to the fibre-product lemma for simplicial objects, and the comparison lemma carries the conclusion across. The card's content is therefore the statement (with its explicit construction) together with the observation that the proof is formal duality, and the two lemmas it names are retained as context.
